verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud hosting and deployment platform, not an AI agent or app that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The evidence shows only Render's own MCP server, which external AI apps such as Claude Code and Cursor connect to. That is the server role and does not show that Render itself can plug in MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
